# Report coverage

How each field of the report's §3.5 methodology and each parameter of its Appendix C sheet (report v1.2) is recorded, as `docs/report/coverage.toml` maps the keys of SPEC 010 Appendix A (TRC-36).

| Key | Kind | Where |
|---|---|---|
| `h.session_id` | column | `call.session_id` |
| `h.turn_index` | column | `call.turn_index` |
| `h.call_index` | column | `call.call_index` |
| `h.input_tokens` | column | `call.input_tokens` |
| `h.cached_input_tokens` | column | `call.cache_read_tokens` |
| `h.output_tokens` | column | `call.output_tokens` |
| `h.stop_reason` | column | `call.stop_reason` |
| `h.ttft` | column | `call.ttft_ns` |
| `h.total_time` | column | `call.duration_ns` |
| `h.preceding_tool_class` | column | `call.preceding_tool_class` |
| `h.preceding_tool_time` | column | `call.preceding_tool_ns` |
| `h.spawn_parent_call` | attribute | `acn.fanout.parent_call` |
| `s.turns_per_session` | column | `session.turns` |
| `s.think_time` | column | `turn.think_time_before_ns` |
| `s.session_lifetime` | column | `session.duration_ns` |
| `t.chain_length` | column | `turn.chain_length` |
| `t.tool_exec_time_by_class` | derived | distribution of tool.duration_ns grouped by tool.tool_class (reads `tool.duration_ns`, `tool.tool_class`) |
| `t.fanout_degree_depth` | derived | joint distribution of turn.fanout_width and turn.fanout_depth (reads `turn.fanout_width`, `turn.fanout_depth`) |
| `t.compaction_vs_length` | derived | share of turns with turn.compaction != none, by the input_tokens of the turn's last main-chain call (reads `turn.compaction`, `turn.turn_index`, `call.input_tokens`, `call.turn_index`, `call.lineage_id`) |
| `c.input_length_by_call_index` | derived | distribution of call.input_tokens grouped by call.call_index (reads `call.input_tokens`, `call.call_index`) |
| `c.new_tokens_per_call` | column | `call.new_input_tokens` |
| `c.output_length_by_call_type` | derived | distribution of call.output_tokens grouped by call.stop_reason (tool_use: a tool call; end_turn: a final answer) (reads `call.output_tokens`, `call.stop_reason`) |
| `c.cached_token_ratio` | column | `call.cached_token_ratio` |
| `b.wire_bytes_per_token` | derived | (call.wire_bytes_up + call.wire_bytes_down) / (call.input_tokens + call.output_tokens) (reads `call.wire_bytes_up`, `call.wire_bytes_down`, `call.input_tokens`, `call.output_tokens`) |
| `b.decode_packet_size_interarrival` | not recorded | a view holds the ITL quantiles (call.itl_p50_ns, call.itl_p99_ns), not the per-packet distribution; instead: sidecar/*.pcapng in netem runs (TRC-41) |
| `b.uplink_bytes_per_tool_result` | derived | distribution of tool.result_bytes grouped by tool.tool_class (reads `tool.result_bytes`, `tool.tool_class`) |
| `f.diurnal_weekly` | not recorded | a run's clock is virtual or monotonic from its start (TRC-26); time of day and week are properties of a fleet, not of one run; instead: none in a bundle: fleet telemetry outside acn-bench; a generator reproduces the pattern from the Appendix C sheet (SPEC 050) |
| `f.cross_session_prefix_overlap` | not recorded | message content is never recorded (TRC-42), so prefixes cannot be compared across sessions; instead: none yet: prefix-block hashes are the planned carrier (SPEC 010 open question 1, POC 11) |
| `f.batch_burst_structure` | not recorded | session start times are span timestamps, not a view column; instead: spans.parquet: start_ns of the acn.session spans of a run |
